limitations: This accepts OPF's declared PHP 7.4 / WordPress 6.5 / WooCommerce 9.0 floor lifecycle only.
It does not prove WAPF Pro/Extended's PHP 7.1 minimum, WAPF Free's older claims, WooCommerce 7.0 compatibility, or parity on their lower floors.
No reproducible stack-provisioning script is included; the disposable install and Chromium harness were prepared under /tmp for this run.
